senses.en: a payment given for professional services that are traditionally done without charge
senses.zh: 酬金；謝禮（演講、審稿等的酬勞）

ex.en: The guest speaker received a modest honorarium for her lecture.
ex.zh: 那位客座講者因為演講拿到一筆不多的酬金。

root.note: 表示敬意而給的錢 → 酬金

senses.en: to deceive or trick someone

ex.en: The scammers tried to hoodwink elderly residents into buying fake insurance.
ex.zh: 詐騙集團想矇騙年長居民購買假保險。

root.note: 用頭罩蒙住眼睛 → 矇騙

mn: hood（頭罩）+ wink（眨眼）：把人眼睛蒙起來，就是矇騙。

senses.en: a large crowd of people or animals

ex.en: A horde of fans rushed toward the stage when the band appeared.
ex.zh: 樂團一出現，一大群歌迷就衝向舞台。

mn: 和 hoard（囤積）同音，注意拼法不同。

senses.en: socks, stockings, and tights as a group

ex.en: The department store keeps its hosiery near the shoe section.
ex.zh: 這家百貨公司把襪類商品擺在鞋區旁邊。

root.note: 各種長襪 → 襪類

senses.en: friendly and welcoming to guests or strangers
(of an environment) pleasant and favorable for living

ex.en: Our hosts were so hospitable that we felt at home immediately.
ex.zh: 主人非常好客，我們馬上就覺得像在家一樣。

root.note: 善待客人的 → 好客的

senses.en: the friendly and generous treatment of guests

ex.en: We thanked the villagers for their warm hospitality.
ex.zh: 我們感謝村民們熱情的款待。

root.note: 善待客人的態度 → 款待

senses.en: unfriendly or aggressive behavior; opposition
(hostilities) acts of warfare

ex.en: The new manager faced open hostility from the staff.
ex.zh: 新經理面對員工公開的敵意。

root.note: 把人當敵人 → 敵意

senses.en: a person who sells things aggressively or dishonestly

ex.en: A huckster at the fair promised his tonic would cure any illness.
ex.zh: 市集上一個小販保證他的補藥能治百病。

senses.en: showing kindness and compassion, especially by avoiding causing pain

ex.en: The shelter uses humane methods to care for stray animals.
ex.zh: 這間收容所用人道的方式照顧流浪動物。

root.note: 有人性的 → 人道的

mn: human（人類的）多一個 e 就變成 humane（人道的），重音也移到後面。

senses.en: concerned with improving people's welfare and reducing suffering
senses.zh: 人道主義的；人道救援的

senses.en: a person who works to improve the lives of others

ex.en: The earthquake created an urgent humanitarian crisis.
ex.zh: 這場地震造成了緊急的人道危機。

root.note: 主張照顧人類福祉 → 人道主義的

senses.en: to make more humane, personal, or relatable
senses.zh: 使人性化；使更有人情味

ex.en: Personal stories can humanize the statistics in a news report.
ex.zh: 個人故事能讓新聞報導中的統計數字更有人味。

root.note: 使有人性 → 人性化

senses.en: deceptive or false talk or behavior; nonsense
a hypocrite or impostor

ex.en: He dismissed the fortune teller's predictions as pure humbug.
ex.zh: 他認為算命師的預言全是胡扯。

mn: 狄更斯《小氣財神》裡 Scrooge 的口頭禪「Bah, humbug!」（胡扯！）。

senses.en: to make someone feel ashamed and foolish

ex.en: A good coach will never humiliate a player in front of the team.
ex.zh: 好教練絕不會在全隊面前羞辱球員。

root.note: 把人壓低 → 羞辱

senses.en: a soldier in a light cavalry regiment, especially in historic European armies

ex.en: The painting shows a hussar in a bright uniform riding into battle.
ex.zh: 這幅畫描繪一名身穿鮮豔制服的輕騎兵騎馬衝入戰場。

senses.en: to push or move someone roughly and hurriedly
busy, energetic activity
to obtain something by forceful or dishonest means

ex.en: Security guards had to hustle the singer through the crowd.
ex.zh: 保全人員得催著歌手快步穿過人群。

mn: 常見片語 hustle and bustle：熙熙攘攘、忙碌喧囂。

senses.en: something made by combining two different elements, such as a plant or animal from two species
made by combining two different elements
senses.zh: 混合的；混種的；油電混合的

ex.en: She traded her old car for a hybrid that uses much less gas.
ex.zh: 她把舊車換成一輛省很多油的油電混合車。

senses.en: a problem that keeps returning or growing despite efforts to solve it
(Greek myth) a many-headed serpent that grew two heads for each one cut off

ex.en: Corruption in the city was a hydra that no mayor could defeat.
ex.zh: 市政的貪腐像九頭蛇一樣，沒有一位市長能根除。

root.note: 住在水澤中的蛇怪 → 九頭蛇

senses.en: operated by the pressure of a liquid moving through pipes

ex.en: The mechanic used a hydraulic lift to raise the car.
ex.zh: 技師用液壓升降機把車子抬起來。

root.note: 水在管子中流動 → 液壓的

senses.en: the branch of physics that studies liquids in motion

ex.en: Engineers study hydrodynamics to design faster and safer ships.
ex.zh: 工程師研究流體動力學來設計更快、更安全的船。

root.note: 研究水的動力的學科 → 流體動力學

senses.en: producing electricity using the power of flowing water

ex.en: The hydroelectric dam supplies power to the entire valley.
ex.zh: 這座水力發電水壩為整個山谷供電。

root.note: 用水產生電的 → 水力發電的

senses.en: the study of the mechanics of fluids, both at rest and in motion

ex.en: A course in hydromechanics is required for civil engineering students.
ex.zh: 土木工程系的學生必須修流體力學。

root.note: 研究水（流體）力學的學科

senses.en: an instrument for measuring the density of liquids

ex.en: The brewer used a hydrometer to check the sugar content of the beer.
ex.zh: 釀酒師用比重計檢查啤酒的含糖量。

root.note: 測量液體的儀器 → 比重計

senses.en: the branch of physics that studies liquids at rest and the pressure they exert

ex.en: The principles of hydrostatics explain why a heavy ship can float.
ex.zh: 流體靜力學的原理解釋了為什麼沉重的船能浮起來。

root.note: 研究靜止的水的學科 → 流體靜力學

senses.en: (chemistry) containing water

ex.en: Gypsum is a hydrous mineral that loses water when heated.
ex.zh: 石膏是一種含水礦物，加熱時會失去水分。

root.note: 含有水的

senses.en: practices that keep people and places clean to prevent disease

ex.en: Good hand hygiene is the simplest way to stop the spread of germs.
ex.zh: 良好的手部衛生是阻止病菌傳播最簡單的方法。

parts.m: healthy 健康（希臘女神 Hygieia）

root.note: 來自健康女神之名 → 衛生

senses.en: too critical, especially of small faults
senses.zh: 吹毛求疵的；過於挑剔的

ex.en: His hypercritical boss found something wrong with every report.
ex.zh: 他那吹毛求疵的上司每份報告都能挑出毛病。

root.note: 過度批評的 → 吹毛求疵的

senses.en: a sleeplike state in which a person responds readily to suggestions

ex.en: Some people use hypnosis to help them quit smoking.
ex.zh: 有些人藉助催眠來戒菸。

root.note: 類似睡眠的狀態 → 催眠

senses.en: holding one's attention as if by hypnosis; mesmerizing
relating to or causing hypnosis or sleep

ex.en: The steady rhythm of the waves had a hypnotic effect on us.
ex.zh: 海浪穩定的節奏讓我們像被催眠了一樣。

root.note: 使人入睡般的 → 催眠的

senses.en: the practice of putting people into hypnosis

ex.en: The magician claimed to use hypnotism to control volunteers on stage.
ex.zh: 魔術師聲稱用催眠術控制台上的志願者。

root.note: 使人入睡般的技術 → 催眠術

senses.en: to put someone into a state of hypnosis
to capture someone's full attention

ex.en: The dancer's graceful movements seemed to hypnotize the audience.
ex.zh: 舞者優雅的動作彷彿讓觀眾都著迷了。

root.note: 使進入似睡狀態 → 催眠

senses.en: pretending to have beliefs or virtues that one does not actually have

ex.en: Voters were angered by the hypocrisy of officials who broke their own rules.
ex.zh: 官員違反自己訂的規定，這種虛偽讓選民很憤怒。

parts.m: judge, act a part 判斷、演戲

root.note: 希臘文原指「演員演戲」→ 裝出來的樣子 → 偽善

senses.en: a person who pretends to have beliefs or virtues that they do not have

ex.en: He felt like a hypocrite for lecturing his kids about junk food.
ex.zh: 他一邊吃零食一邊教訓孩子別吃垃圾食物，覺得自己像個偽君子。

parts.m: judge, act a part 判斷、演戲

root.note: 希臘文原指「演員」→ 裝模作樣的人 → 偽君子

senses.en: relating to the area under the skin; used for injecting under the skin
a hypodermic needle or syringe

ex.en: The nurse carefully disposed of the used hypodermic needle.
ex.zh: 護理師小心地處理用過的皮下注射針頭。

root.note: 皮膚之下的 → 皮下的

senses.en: the longest side of a right triangle, opposite the right angle

ex.en: Use the Pythagorean theorem to find the length of the hypotenuse.
ex.zh: 用畢氏定理求出斜邊的長度。

root.note: 在直角下方伸展開的邊 → 斜邊

senses.en: a proposed explanation that can be tested by further investigation

ex.en: The students designed an experiment to test their hypothesis.
ex.zh: 學生們設計實驗來驗證他們的假說。

root.note: 放在論證底下作為基礎 → 假說

senses.en: extreme, uncontrollable emotion or excitement, often shared by a group
senses.zh: 歇斯底里；（群眾的）狂熱恐慌

ex.en: Rumors of a shortage led to mass hysteria at the supermarket.
ex.zh: 缺貨的謠言在超市引發群眾恐慌。

senses.en: relating to fish

ex.en: The fossil showed clear ichthyic features such as fins and gills.
ex.zh: 這塊化石顯示出鰭和鰓等明顯的魚類特徵。

root.note: 魚的

senses.en: the scientific study of fish

ex.en: Her love of aquariums led her to study ichthyology in college.
ex.zh: 她對水族箱的熱愛讓她在大學主修魚類學。

root.note: 研究魚的學問 → 魚類學

senses.en: (plural) extinct marine reptiles with fish-like bodies that lived in the age of dinosaurs
senses.zh: 魚龍（已滅絕的海生爬蟲類，複數）

ex.en: Ichthyosaurs swam in ancient seas long before whales existed.
ex.zh: 魚龍早在鯨魚出現之前就在遠古海洋中游動。

root.note: 像魚的蜥蜴 → 魚龍

senses.en: in a very cold and unfriendly way

ex.en: "I have nothing to say to you," she replied icily.
ex.zh: 「我沒什麼話好跟你說。」她冷冰冰地回答。

root.note: 像冰一樣地 → 冷冰冰地

senses.en: the state of being icy; extreme coldness or unfriendliness

ex.en: The iciness in his voice told me he was still angry.
ex.zh: 他語氣中的冰冷讓我知道他還在生氣。

root.note: 像冰一樣的狀態 → 冰冷

senses.en: a person or thing regarded as a symbol of something
senses.zh: 偶像；代表性人物或事物

senses.en: a small picture on a screen that represents a program or function
a religious painting, especially in Eastern Christianity

ex.en: The Eiffel Tower has become an icon of Paris.
ex.zh: 艾菲爾鐵塔已成為巴黎的象徵。

senses.en: to regard or represent something as better than it really is

ex.en: It is easy to idealize the past and forget its hardships.
ex.zh: 人很容易把過去理想化，而忘了當時的艱辛。

root.note: 使成為理想的 → 理想化

senses.en: a group of words whose meaning differs from the meanings of the individual words
a characteristic style of a language, artist, or period

ex.en: "Break a leg" is an idiom that means "good luck."
ex.zh: 「Break a leg」是個慣用語，意思是「祝好運」。

parts.m: one's own, peculiar 自己的、特有的

root.note: 某語言特有的說法 → 慣用語

senses.en: a peculiar habit or way of behaving that is typical of one person

ex.en: One idiosyncrasy of my uncle is that he eats dessert before dinner.
ex.zh: 我叔叔有個怪癖，就是晚餐前先吃甜點。

root.note: 個人特有的性情組合 → 怪癖

senses.en: to admire or love someone greatly or excessively

ex.en: Many young players idolize the team's star striker.
ex.zh: 許多年輕球員把隊上的明星前鋒當偶像崇拜。

root.note: 當成偶像 → 崇拜

senses.en: not honorable in character or purpose; shameful
of humble birth

ex.en: Winning by cheating is an ignoble victory.
ex.zh: 靠作弊贏來的是不光彩的勝利。

root.note: 不高貴的 → 卑鄙的

senses.en: causing public shame or embarrassment

ex.en: The champion suffered an ignominious defeat in the first round.
ex.zh: 衛冕者在第一輪就吞下丟臉的敗仗。

root.note: 失去好名聲的 → 可恥的

senses.en: the ancient Greek epic poem attributed to Homer about the Trojan War
(iliad) a long series of disasters or a long story
senses.zh: 一連串的災難；長篇故事

ex.en: The Iliad describes the anger of Achilles during the siege of Troy.
ex.zh: 《伊利亞德》描寫阿基里斯在特洛伊圍城期間的憤怒。

root.note: 關於特洛伊城的史詩

senses.en: bad-tempered and unkind

ex.en: The ill-natured neighbor yelled at children who stepped on his lawn.
ex.zh: 那個壞脾氣的鄰居會對踩到他草坪的小孩大吼。

root.note: 天性不好的 → 脾氣壞的

senses.en: not allowed by law

ex.en: It is illegal to drive without a valid license.
ex.zh: 無照駕駛是違法的。

root.note: 不合法的

senses.en: impossible or very hard to read

ex.en: The doctor's handwriting was so illegible that the pharmacist called to check.
ex.zh: 醫生的字跡潦草到藥師得打電話確認。

root.note: 無法讀的 → 難以辨認的

senses.en: not allowed by law or rules; not valid
(of a child) born to parents not married to each other

ex.en: The opposition called the rushed election illegitimate.
ex.zh: 反對黨稱這場倉促舉行的選舉不具正當性。

root.note: 不合法的 → 不正當的

senses.en: opposed to free thought or individual rights; intolerant
senses.zh: 偏狹的；不自由的；壓制言論的

senses.en: (old use) stingy; ungenerous

ex.en: Critics warned that the illiberal law would silence journalists.
ex.zh: 批評者警告，這項壓制自由的法律會讓記者噤聲。

root.note: 不自由的 → 偏狹的

senses.en: forbidden by law, rules, or custom

ex.en: Police seized a large shipment of illicit drugs at the port.
ex.zh: 警方在港口查獲一大批非法毒品。

root.note: 不被允許的 → 非法的

mn: 別和 elicit（引出）搞混：兩字發音幾乎一樣。

senses.en: without limits; boundless

ex.en: Standing on the shore, she gazed at the illimitable ocean.
ex.zh: 她站在岸邊，凝望著無邊無際的大海。

root.note: 無法限制的 → 無限的

senses.en: unable to read or write
lacking knowledge in a particular field

ex.en: Volunteers teach illiterate adults to read at the community center.
ex.zh: 志工在社區中心教不識字的成人讀書。

root.note: 不懂文字的 → 文盲的

senses.en: lacking sense or clear, sound reasoning

ex.en: It seems illogical to buy an umbrella after the rain has stopped.
ex.zh: 雨都停了才買雨傘，似乎不太合理。

root.note: 不合道理的

senses.en: something that gives off light
giving off light

ex.en: Before electricity, whale oil was a common illuminant in homes.
ex.zh: 在有電之前，鯨油是家庭常用的照明燃料。

root.note: 照亮的東西 → 光源

senses.en: to light up
to help clarify or explain

ex.en: Her research helps illuminate how memory works in the brain.
ex.zh: 她的研究有助於闡明大腦中記憶如何運作。

root.note: 把光照在上面 → 照亮；闡明

senses.en: (literary) to light up or enlighten

ex.en: The poet prayed for wisdom to illumine his troubled mind.
ex.zh: 詩人祈求智慧來啟迪他困惑的心靈。

root.note: 把光照在上面 → 照亮

senses.en: a false idea or belief
something that appears different from what it really is

ex.en: Large mirrors create the illusion of a bigger room.
ex.zh: 大鏡子能營造房間比較大的錯覺。

root.note: 被玩弄的感官 → 錯覺

senses.en: deceptive; based on illusion

ex.en: The promise of quick riches proved to be illusive.
ex.zh: 一夕致富的承諾結果只是虛幻的。

root.note: 玩弄感官的 → 虛幻的

mn: 別和 elusive（難以捉摸的）搞混。

senses.en: based on illusion; not real

ex.en: The sense of safety behind the old wall was illusory.
ex.zh: 躲在舊牆後面的安全感只是一種假象。

root.note: 玩弄感官的 → 虛幻的

senses.en: possible to think of or imagine

ex.en: The shop sells every flavor of ice cream imaginable.
ex.zh: 這家店賣你想得到的每一種冰淇淋口味。

root.note: 能想像的

senses.en: existing only in the imagination

ex.en: The little girl had tea parties with her imaginary friend.
ex.zh: 那個小女孩會和她想像中的朋友一起開茶會。

root.note: 只存在於想像中的

mn: imaginary（想像中的）vs. imaginative（有想像力的）。

senses.en: to drink, especially alcohol
to absorb ideas or knowledge

ex.en: Children often imbibe their parents' attitudes without realizing it.
ex.zh: 孩子常在不知不覺中吸收父母的態度。

root.note: 喝進去 → 飲；吸收

senses.en: a complicated and embarrassing situation or conflict

ex.en: The minister was caught up in a political imbroglio over the missing funds.
ex.zh: 部長捲入一場關於失蹤款項的政治糾紛。

root.note: 纏成一團 → 糾葛

senses.en: (literary) to stain, especially with blood

ex.en: The old ballad tells of warriors who would imbrue their swords in battle.
ex.zh: 這首古老歌謠講述戰士們在戰場上讓劍沾滿鮮血。

root.note: 浸入 → 沾染

senses.en: the act of copying someone or something
a copy made to look like something else

ex.en: The bag looked expensive, but it was only a cheap imitation.
ex.zh: 那個包包看起來很貴，其實只是廉價的仿冒品。

root.note: 模仿

senses.en: a person or thing that copies another

ex.en: The popular app quickly attracted many imitators, but no imitator matched its quality.
ex.zh: 這款熱門應用程式很快就引來許多仿效者，但沒有一個比得上它的品質。

root.note: 模仿的人

senses.en: perfectly clean and tidy
free from mistakes or flaws

ex.en: The hotel room was immaculate when we arrived.
ex.zh: 我們抵達時，旅館房間一塵不染。

root.note: 沒有污點的 → 一塵不染

senses.en: unimportant; not relevant
not physical; spiritual

ex.en: Whether you arrive by bus or train is immaterial, as long as you are on time.
ex.zh: 只要準時到，你搭公車還是火車都無所謂。

root.note: 沒有實質的 → 無關緊要的

senses.en: behaving in a childish way
not fully grown or developed

ex.en: It was immature of him to sulk after losing the game.
ex.zh: 他輸了比賽就生悶氣，真是幼稚。

root.note: 未成熟的

senses.en: too large or great to be measured

ex.en: Her kindness had an immeasurable impact on my life.
ex.zh: 她的善良對我的人生有難以估量的影響。

root.note: 無法測量的

senses.en: extremely large or great

ex.en: Building the bridge required an immense amount of steel.
ex.zh: 建造這座橋需要大量的鋼材。

root.note: 大到無法測量 → 巨大的

senses.en: to put something completely into a liquid
to involve oneself deeply in an activity

ex.en: The best way to learn a language is to immerse yourself in it.
ex.zh: 學語言最好的方法是讓自己沉浸在那個語言環境中。

root.note: 浸入其中

senses.en: the act of putting something completely in a liquid
deep involvement in an activity or environment

ex.en: The school offers a Spanish immersion program for young children.
ex.zh: 這所學校為幼童提供西班牙語沉浸式課程。

root.note: 浸入其中 → 沉浸

senses.en: a person who comes to live permanently in a foreign country

ex.en: My grandfather arrived as an immigrant with only one suitcase.
ex.zh: 我祖父以移民身分來到這裡時，只帶了一個行李箱。

root.note: 遷移進來的人 → 移民

mn: im-（進來）是 immigrant；e-（出去）是 emigrant。

senses.en: to come to live permanently in a foreign country

ex.en: Her parents decided to immigrate to Canada in the 1990s.
ex.zh: 她的父母在 1990 年代決定移民到加拿大。

root.note: 遷移進來 → 移入

senses.en: the state of being about to happen

ex.en: The imminence of the storm forced officials to close the schools.
ex.zh: 暴風雨迫在眉睫，官方只得下令停課。

parts.m: project, hang over 突出、懸垂

root.note: 懸在頭上 → 迫近

senses.en: about to happen very soon

ex.en: Dark clouds warned us that rain was imminent.
ex.zh: 烏雲警告我們雨快要下了。

parts.m: project, hang over 突出、懸垂

root.note: 懸在頭上的 → 迫在眉睫的

mn: 別和 eminent（傑出的）搞混：imminent 是「即將發生」。

senses.en: (of liquids) not able to be mixed together

ex.en: Oil and water are immiscible, so they separate into layers.
ex.zh: 油和水不互溶，所以會分成兩層。

root.note: 不能混合的

senses.en: not following accepted standards of right behavior

ex.en: Many people think it is immoral to profit from someone else's suffering.
ex.zh: 許多人認為從別人的痛苦中獲利是不道德的。

root.note: 不道德的

mn: immoral（不道德的）≠ amoral（無道德觀念的）。

senses.en: to make someone or something famous or remembered forever

ex.en: The artist wanted to immortalize her hometown in a series of paintings.
ex.zh: 這位畫家想用一系列畫作讓她的家鄉永垂不朽。

root.note: 使不死 → 使不朽

senses.en: not able to be moved
unwilling to change one's opinion

ex.en: On the issue of safety, the principal was immovable.
ex.zh: 在安全問題上，校長的立場堅定不移。

root.note: 無法移動的

senses.en: protected against a disease
not affected by something; exempt

ex.en: No one is immune to criticism in politics.
ex.zh: 在政治圈沒有人能免於批評。

root.note: 免除義務的 → 豁免；免疫

senses.en: unchanging over time; unable to be changed
senses.zh: 不可改變的；永恆不變的

ex.en: Scientists once believed the continents were immutable.
ex.zh: 科學家曾經認為大陸是永恆不變的。

root.note: 無法改變的

senses.en: to weaken or damage something

ex.en: Lack of sleep can impair your ability to concentrate.
ex.zh: 睡眠不足會削弱你的專注力。

root.note: 使變得更糟 → 損害

senses.en: unable to be felt by touch
not easily understood

ex.en: An impalpable sadness hung over the empty house.
ex.zh: 一股說不出的哀傷籠罩著那棟空屋。

root.note: 摸不到的

senses.en: treating all sides equally; fair and unbiased

ex.en: A judge must remain impartial throughout the trial.
ex.zh: 法官在整個審判過程中必須保持公正。

root.note: 不站在任何一方的 → 公正的

senses.en: impossible to travel along or across

ex.en: Heavy snow made the mountain road impassable.
ex.zh: 大雪使山路無法通行。

root.note: 無法通過的

senses.en: incapable of feeling pain or emotion
senses.zh: 無感覺的；不受痛苦影響的

ex.en: The old monk seemed impassible, untouched by either joy or grief.
ex.zh: 老僧似乎無動於衷，喜悲都無法觸動他。

root.note: 不能感受痛苦的 → 無感覺的

mn: pass 在這裡是 passion 的「受苦」，不是「通過」；別和 impassable 搞混。

senses.en: not showing any emotion

ex.en: The guard's face remained impassive as the tourists tried to make him laugh.
ex.zh: 遊客們想逗那名衛兵笑，他卻始終面無表情。

root.note: 不表露感受的 → 面無表情的

senses.en: a tendency to be irritated by delays; eagerness

ex.en: The crowd's impatience grew as the concert started late.
ex.zh: 演唱會延遲開始，觀眾越來越不耐煩。

root.note: 無法忍受的 → 不耐煩

senses.en: without any faults; perfect

ex.en: The waiter spoke impeccable French.
ex.zh: 那名服務生說一口無可挑剔的法語。

root.note: 不會犯錯的 → 完美的

senses.en: having little or no money

ex.en: As an impecunious student, he lived on instant noodles.
ex.zh: 身為窮學生，他靠泡麵過活。

root.note: 沒有錢的 → 貧窮的

senses.en: to slow or block progress

ex.en: Fallen trees impede traffic after every major storm.
ex.zh: 每次大暴風雨過後，倒下的樹都會阻礙交通。

root.note: 把腳套住 → 阻礙

senses.en: to drive or force someone to do something

ex.en: Curiosity may impel a child to take apart a clock.
ex.zh: 好奇心可能驅使孩子把時鐘拆開。

root.note: 推向前 → 驅使

senses.en: to be about to happen, especially something bad
senses.zh: 迫近；即將發生（多指壞事）

ex.en: Few people noticed the danger that seemed to impend over the town.
ex.zh: 很少人注意到那股似乎正籠罩小鎮、即將來臨的危險。

root.note: 懸在頭上 → 迫近
